verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's CUDA Toolkit and developer.nvidia.com/rtx docs explicitly list this Blackwell-based workstation GPU as a supported CUDA target, with libraries (RAPIDS, cuTile, Transformer Engine, CUDA-X) and hands-on community usage (multi-GPU inference at 41k tok/s) confirming real deployment. However, community evidence also flags a concrete gap: as an SM120 part it lacks tmem/tcgen05 support and 'main libraries' focus is on SM100 (B300) instead, meaning some newer CUDA library features are not yet fully supported on this specific chip. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly addressing SM120 library-support gaps, and clearer confirmation that all CUDA-X libraries fully support this exact SKU rather than the data-center Blackwell variant.
